    Exeter Innovation

    Exeter Innovation is a partner for transformative innovation. We harness the world leading research and education of the University of Exeter to create real and lasting impact, by working with organisations of all types and sizes on their innovation journey.

Contact us

Find a person

  • Find academic staff: University of Exeter expert search.
  • For phone numbers search the University phone directory at Enhanced Directory Search (Internal access only).
  • For email addresses visit https://outlook.office365.com/mail/ select New email, click on the To field then Default Global Address List and search the list (Internal access only).

General telephone enquiries

Please call the main switchboard on +44 (0) 1392 661000

Penryn Campus

If you specifically require the Penryn Campus, the main reception number is +44 (0) 1326 370400.

Contact departments and offices

You can contact an academic faculty, department or professional service by e-mail or phone. Contact details are available on their individual sites.

If you have complaints about email which is being sent to you from a University of Exeter email account you should contact our abuse address.

Course enquiries

  • Order a prospectus
  • Visit us or join an open day
  • Admissions: Enquire online 0300 555 60 60 (UK callers)* +44 (0)1392 723044 (EU/International callers)
  • International student enquiries: Enquire online
  • Visiting and course related enquiries: Enquire online +44 (0)1392 727272
  • Study Abroad: inbound@exeter.ac.uk; outbound@exeter.ac.uk
  • Student finance enquiries: 0300 555 0444 (UK); +441392 724724 (EU/International); pre-enrolment@exeter.ac.uk
  • Accommodation in Exeter: 0300 555 0444 (UK callers); 0044 1392 724724 (EU/International callers); ExeterAO@exeter.ac.uk
  • Accommodation in Cornwall: +44 (0) 1326 253639; accommodation@fxplus.ac.uk
  • INTO International Study Centre: +44 (0) 1392 724282; into@exeter.ac.uk

*Calling us on an 0300 number will cost you the same as a call to a standard landline number starting with 01 and 02.

If you have an inclusive call package for calling landline numbers on your mobile or landline telephone the call would simply be reduced from your available talk minutes. Otherwise your call will be charged at the same rate as calling a standard national rate number.

University reception

The University's reception handles general enquiries and visitors to the University. The address for the reception is:

University of Exeter Reception
Stocker Road
Exeter EX4 4PY

Telephone: +44 (0) 1392 661000

Access information for the main reception is available on the AccessAble website.

Postal address

General mail for the University should be addressed to:

The University of Exeter
Mail Room, The Old Library
Prince of Wales Road
Exeter, Devon UK
EX4 4SB
